source_snapshot_scope: Selected verified FCA HTML passages and claim register, not a full archival copy of the FCA source

claims_checked.claim: 1.85 million complaints received in 2026 H1; 6.3% rise over 2025 H2 (1.74 million)
Current accounts remain the most complained-about individual product by volume
44.8% closed within three days; 49.7% between three days and eight weeks; 94.5% within eight weeks, 5.5% longer
Aggregate totals include more than 3,000 regulated firms
Consumer-credit-only firms excluded from aggregate totals
Firm-level thresholds 500/half-year or 1,000/year for certain firms
Complaints volumes shouldn't alone indicate firm quality; consider customer base and other metrics
Upheld and redress are distinct measures; no unsupported causal equivalence

editor_notes: AI-authored first full article. Figures, scope and important qualifiers checked against the FCA's original public 22 October 2026 complaints-data HTML. No human editor approved it; no claims about independent examination of the downloadable spreadsheet.
residual_risk: AI source review can miss errors. FCA may revise reported figures.
